opportunity.name: CPCA HCCN Connect Marketplace Vendor Pool

mandatory_direct_prime_gates.description: Maintain required business licensing, certification, insurance, and accreditation.
Prior FQHC/look-alike/safety-net primary care experience; at least one cited comparable engagement must directly support an eligible health-center/safety-net organization.
Cultural competency/non-discriminatory practice, including rural/agricultural-worker experience where applicable.
Capacity for timely, concurrent TA engagements.
Capable of virtual delivery and/or California presence.
Can comply with CPCA reporting, invoicing, and oversight.
Satisfactory references; application requires at least 3 client references.
Specific subject-matter expertise for every selected domain.
Named key personnel/subcontractors with roles, credentials, years of experience, resumes, and domain qualifications.
Proposed key personnel directly participated in comparable engagements.
For TA: individualized hands-on consulting/project support with defined workplans, deliverables, implementation/troubleshooting/coaching, milestones and results.
For Group Training: structured curriculum, learning objectives, facilitation, adaptation, evaluation, reusable materials.
Established domains need 3 comparable engagements in 3 years; emerging domains need 1 completed/substantially completed in 2 years plus 1 additional completed/active/pilot engagement.
Working knowledge of applicable federal/state requirements, standards and current-practice monitoring.
Completed proposed rate structure using Appendix B.
Authorized signature on licensing, non-discrimination and conflict-of-interest attestation.
Combined narrative, resumes, references, Domain Qualification Matrix, rate sheet and signed attestations into one PDF.
Authorized operator must control final Smartsheet submission; source tooling does not infer this authority.
